# nemau_dns_zone (Resource)

An authoritative DNS zone.

`description`, `email` and `ttl` change in place. Changing `name` replaces the zone and deletes every record in it, so read the plan before applying such a change.

A new zone is not served until you prove that you control its domain. It is created with status `PENDING_VERIFICATION`: publish a TXT record named `verification_record_name` holding `verification_record_value` at the domain's current DNS host, then declare a `nemau_dns_zone_verification`, which waits for the platform to find it. Record sets are refused on a pending zone, so take their `zone_id` from the verification resource.

The API stops returning the record once the zone is active. The provider keeps the values it last read instead of clearing them, so a TXT record declared from them with another DNS provider does not show a diff after the verification.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_dns_zone" "main" {
  name  = "example.com."
  email = "hostmaster@example.com"
}

# Publish this TXT record at the domain's current DNS host. The zone serves
# nothing until nemau_dns_zone_verification has found it.
output "verification_record" {
  value = {
    name  = nemau_dns_zone.main.verification_record_name
    type  = "TXT"
    value = nemau_dns_zone.main.verification_record_value
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Contact address published in the zone's SOA record, for example `hostmaster@example.com`. Changes in place.
- `name` (String) Zone name, fully qualified, for example `example.com.`. Changing it replaces the zone and deletes its records.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description, one line. Changes in place.
- `ttl` (Number) Default TTL of the zone, in seconds, `300` when not set. Changes in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The zone's id, a UUID. Import takes this id, not the zone's name.
- `status` (String) `PENDING_VERIFICATION` until the domain's ownership is proven, then `ACTIVE`. Refreshed on every read; an in-place update keeps the last value read.
- `verification_record_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the TXT record that proves ownership, such as `_nemau-challenge.example.com.`. Kept after the verification; null for a zone imported once already active.
- `verification_record_value` (String) The exact text the TXT record must hold (`nemau-verification=…`). Kept after the verification, like `verification_record_name`.

## Import

```shell
# A zone imports by its id, a UUID, not by its name.
terraform import nemau_dns_zone.main 3f1c9a2e-7b4d-4e8a-9c61-2d5f0b8e4a17
```
